title: Call of minecraft
description: Call of Minecraft is a Call of Duty-inspired Minecraft modpack focused on modern weapons, fast-paced combat, shaders, and smooth performance. With Essential included, you can easily play and host multiplayer games with your friends and experience tactical
body:
Call of Minecraft is a combat-focused modpack that transforms Minecraft into a fast-paced shooter experience inspired by Call of Duty. The pack introduces modern weapons, tactical combat mechanics, improved performance, and visual enhancements to create intense multiplayer battles inside the Minecraft world.

At the core of the experience is Superb Warfare, which adds realistic firearms, attachments, and combat systems that bring modern warfare gameplay into Minecraft. Combined with performance and optimization mods like Embeddium, Entity Culling, and FerriteCore, the modpack is designed to run smoothly even during large firefights.

The modpack also includes Oculus for shader support, allowing players to use shaders for enhanced lighting, shadows, and overall visual quality. Additionally, Essential is included so you can easily host worlds and play with friends without needing a dedicated server.

Various library and support mods such as Geckolib, Curios API, Cloth Config, Konkrete, and Melody ensure compatibility and stability while supporting advanced animations and features.

Whether you're battling friends in PvP firefights or creating your own war scenarios, Call of Minecraft aims to deliver a modern combat experience inside Minecraft.
